newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Ericsson introduces world small PCS phone.
newsitem.headline: Ericsson introduces world small PCS phone.

text.p: Swedish telecoms group AB LM Ericsson said on Tuesday it has introduced the world's smallest Personal Communication System (PCS) phone, weighing 135 grams (4.7 ounces) and measuring 10 centimetres (four inches) high.
"The new Ericsson CF 788 is built for the PCS 1900 system (a North American version of the standard Global System for Mobile telecommunications, GSM)," the company said in a statement.
The phone has three hours of talk time and 48 hours of standby time.
